#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and current date."""
import datetime
import io
import os
import tempfile

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas


def main() -> None:
    src = "report.pdf"
    reader = PdfReader(src)
    if not reader.pages:
        raise SystemExit("report.pdf has no pages")

    # Match the cover page size to the first page of the report.
    first = reader.pages[0]
    w, h = float(first.mediabox.width), float(first.mediabox.height)

    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_line = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=(w, h))
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.10, 0.12, 0.16)
    c.rect(0, 0, w, h, stroke=0, fill=1)

    c.setFillColorRGB(1, 1, 1)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", min(w, h) / 14)
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    c.drawCentredString(w / 2, h * 0.58, title)

    c.setFont("Helvetica", min(w, h) / 30)
    c.drawCentredString(w / 2, h * 0.45, date_line)

    c.setStrokeColorRGB(1, 1, 1)
    c.setLineWidth(1.5)
    c.line(w * 0.25, h * 0.52, w * 0.75, h * 0.52)
    c.save()
    buf.seek(0)

    cover_reader = PdfReader(buf)
    cover_page = cover_reader.pages[0]

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_page)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=".", prefix=".report_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        with open(tmp, "wb") as fh:
            writer.write(fh)
        os.replace(tmp, src)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.remove(tmp)

    out = PdfReader(src)
    print(f"Wrote {src} with {len(out.pages)} pages (1 cover + {len(reader.pages)} original).")
    print(f"Cover: title={title!r}, date={date_line!r}, size={w:.0f}x{h:.0f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from pypdf import PdfReader

# Look for report.pdf in the current directory and common subdirectories
candidates = ["report.pdf"] + glob.glob("**/report.pdf", recursive=True)
found = None

    if os.path.isfile(c):
        found = c
        break

print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
print("Found:", found)

if found:
    reader = PdfReader(found)
    print("Pages:", len(reader.pages))
    for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages[:3]):
        box = page.mediabox
        print(f"Page {i+1} size: {float(box.width):.1f} x {float(box.height):.1f} pts")

"""Inspect report.pdf: page count, page size, metadata, form fields."""
import sys
from pypdf import PdfReader

    print(f"  {k}: {v}")

    print(f"  text preview: {text[:120]!r}")
fields = reader.get_fields()
if fields:
    print(f"Form fields: {list(fields.keys())}")
else:
    print("Form fields: none")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and current date.

Uses only pypdf (no reportlab dependency): the cover page is a blank page whose
content stream is built by hand with the standard Helvetica base-14 fonts.
"""
import datetime
import os
import tempfile

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import DecodedStreamObject, DictionaryObject, NameObject

# Standard Helvetica glyph widths in 1/1000 em (Adobe AFM values) for the
# ASCII characters that may appear in the title/date strings.
WIDTHS = {
    " ": 278, "!": 278, '"': 355, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 667,
    "'": 191, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 278, ";": 278,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 556, "@": 1015, "A": 667, "B": 667,
    "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778, "H": 722, "I": 278,
    "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667,
    "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944,
    "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611, "[": 278, "\\": 278, "]": 278, "^": 469,
    "_": 556, "`": 333, "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556,
    "f": 278, "g": 556, "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222,
    "m": 833, "n": 556, "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500,
    "t": 278, "u": 556, "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
    "{": 334, "|": 260, "}": 334, "~": 584,
}


def text_width(text: str, font_size: float) -> float:
    total = sum(WIDTHS.get(ch, 556) for ch in text)
    return total / 1000.0 * font_size


def esc(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def num(v: float) -> str:
    return "%.4f" % v


def main() -> None:
    src = "report.pdf"
    reader = PdfReader(src)
    if not reader.pages:
        raise SystemExit("report.pdf has no pages")

    # Match the cover page size to the first page of the report.
    first = reader.pages[0]
    w = float(first.mediabox.width)
    h = float(first.mediabox.height)

    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_line = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    title = "Annual Financial Report"

    title_size = min(w, h) / 14.0
    date_size = min(w, h) / 30.0
    title_x = (w - text_width(title, title_size)) / 2.0
    title_y = h * 0.58
    date_x = (w - text_width(date_line, date_size)) / 2.0
    date_y = h * 0.45

    stream = (
        # Dark background.
        "q\n"
        "0.10 0.12 0.16 rg\n"
        "0 0 %s %s re f\n"
        "Q\n"
        # Horizontal divider line.
        "q\n"
        "1 1 1 RG\n"
        "1.5 w\n"
        "%s %s m %s %s l S\n"
        "Q\n"
        # Title (Helvetica-Bold).
        "q\n"
        "1 1 1 rg\n"
        "BT\n"
        "/F2 %s Tf\n"
        "1 0 0 1 %s %s Tm\n"
        "(%s) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "Q\n"
        # Date (Helvetica).
        "q\n"
        "1 1 1 rg\n"
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 %s Tf\n"
        "1 0 0 1 %s %s Tm\n"
        "(%s) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "Q\n"
    ) % (
        num(w), num(h),
        num(w * 0.25), num(h * 0.52), num(w * 0.75), num(h * 0.52),
        num(title_size), num(title_x), num(title_y), esc(title),
        num(date_size), num(date_x), num(date_y), esc(date_line),
    )

    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover = writer.add_blank_page(width=w, height=h)
    cover[NameObject("/Resources")] = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Font"): DictionaryObject({
            NameObject("/F1"): DictionaryObject({
                NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
                NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
                NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica"),
            }),
            NameObject("/F2"): DictionaryObject({
                NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
                NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
                NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica-Bold"),
            }),
        })
    })
    content = DecodedStreamObject()
    content.set_data(stream.encode("latin-1"))
    cover[NameObject("/Contents")] = content

    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=".", prefix=".report_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        with open(tmp, "wb") as fh:
            writer.write(fh)
        os.replace(tmp, src)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.remove(tmp)

    # Validate: reopen and check page count and extracted cover text.
    out = PdfReader(src)
    cover_text = out.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    print(f"Wrote {src} with {len(out.pages)} pages (1 cover + {len(reader.pages)} original).")
    print(f"Cover: title={title!r}, date={date_line!r}, size={w:.0f}x{h:.0f}")
    print(f"Extracted cover text: {cover_text!r}")
    if title not in cover_text:
        raise SystemExit("Validation failed: title not found in extracted cover text")
    if date_line not in cover_text:
        print("Warning: date not found in extracted cover text (extraction quirk)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
